title: Engineering the MmeFz2-omegaRNA system for efficient genome editing through an integrated computational-experimental framework.
authors: Li, Shangpu; Xu, Kun; Li, Guoling; Jiang, Henan; Wu, Zhenmin; Gao, Pengfei; Yue, Yang; Chen, Yufei; Liu, Zujiang; Zhou, Bingqian; Zhou, Min; Chen, Yulin; Liu, Xu; Wang, Xiaolong; Wu, Zhaowei; Wei, Yinghui
one_liner_zh: 该文利用AlphaFold3和AI辅助工程优化Fanzor RNA引导核酸酶用于基因组编辑，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合域（HMG-D）融合，但核心是核酸酶编辑效率优化而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Eukaryotic Fanzor proteins are compact, programmable RNA-guided nucleases with substantial potential for genome editing, although their efficiency in mammalian cells remains suboptimal. Here, we present a combinatorial engineering strategy to optimize a representative Fanzor system, MmeFz2-omegaRNA. AlphaFold3-powered rational redesign produced a minimized omegaRNA scaffold that is 30% smaller while maintaining up to 82.2% efficiency. Synergistic structure-guided and AI-augmented protein engineering generated two variants, enMmeFz2 and evoMmeFz2, which exhibited an average ~32-fold increase in activity across 38 genomic loci. Moreover, fusion of the non-specific DNA-binding domain HMG-D further enhanced editing performance (enMmeFz2-HMG-D and evoMmeFz2-HMG-D). Notably, evoMmeFz2-HMG-D demonstrated robust in vivo genome editing activity, enabling dystrophin restoration in humanized male Duchenne muscular dystrophy mouse models via single adeno-associated virus (AAV) delivery. This study establishes Fanzor2 as a gene editing platform for genome engineering and therapeutic applications, and underscores the power of AI-guided engineering to accelerate genome editor development while reducing experimental burden.
abstract_zh: 真核Fanzor蛋白是紧凑、可编程的RNA引导核酸酶，在基因组编辑方面具有巨大潜力，尽管其在哺乳动物细胞中的效率仍不理想。在此，我们提出一种组合工程策略，以优化代表性Fanzor系统MmeFz2-omegaRNA。AlphaFold3驱动的理性重设计产生了一个最小化的omegaRNA支架，其体积缩小30%，同时保持高达82.2%的效率。协同的结构引导和AI增强蛋白工程生成了两个变体enMmeFz2和evoMmeFz2，它们在38个基因组位点上平均活性提高约32倍。此外，非特异性DNA结合域HMG-D的融合进一步增强了编辑性能（enMmeFz2-HMG-D和evoMmeFz2-HMG-D）。值得注意的是，evoMmeFz2-HMG-D展示了强大的体内基因组编辑活性，通过单腺相关病毒（AAV）递送，在人类化雄性杜氏肌营养不良小鼠模型中实现了肌营养不良蛋白的恢复。本研究确立了Fanzor2作为基因组工程和治疗应用的基因编辑平台，并强调了AI引导工程在加速基因组编辑器开发同时减少实验负担方面的力量。
